## Shapiro test

```{r shapiro_wild_accli, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
alpha_div %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(., sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == Tube_code)) %>%
  filter(time_point =="Acclimation") %>% 
  filter(metric=="richness") %>% 
  summarize(shapiro_p_value = shapiro.test(value)$p.value) %>%
  pull(shapiro_p_value)

alpha_div %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(., sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == Tube_code)) %>%
  filter(time_point =="Acclimation") %>% 
  filter(metric=="neutral") %>% 
  summarize(shapiro_p_value = shapiro.test(value)$p.value) %>%

alpha_div %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(., sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == Tube_code)) %>%
```

## Alpha diversity
```{r alpha_div_plot_accli, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=4, fig.width=8, fig.fullwidth=TRUE}
alpha_div %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(., sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == Tube_code)) %>%
  filter(time_point=="Acclimation") %>%
  mutate(metric=factor(metric,levels=c("richness","neutral","phylogenetic"))) %>%
      ggplot(aes(y = value, x = species, group=species, color=species, fill=species)) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
      geom_jitter(alpha=0.5) +
      scale_color_manual(name="species",
          breaks=c("Podarcis_muralis","Podarcis_liolepis"),
          labels=c("Podarcis muralis","Podarcis liolepis"),
          values=c('#008080', "#d57d2c")) +
      scale_fill_manual(name="species",
          breaks=c("Podarcis_muralis","Podarcis_liolepis"),
          labels=c("Podarcis muralis","Podarcis liolepis"),
          values=c('#00808050', "#d57d2c50")) +
      facet_wrap(. ~ metric,scales = "free") +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1, NA)) +
      stat_compare_means(method="t.test",size=3, label.x=.58) +
      theme_classic() +
        theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(size = .1, color = "grey"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size=10),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    # Increase plot size
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8)
      ) +
  ylab("Alpha diversity")
```

```{r alpha_div_tests_accli, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Species comparison of alpha diversity after acclimation. The figure uses the Welch t-test
# (ggpubr default); Student t-test, variance test and Wilcoxon test are given for reference.
# Manuscript: warm-adapted higher diversity (p < 0.05, Supplementary Fig. S1); phylogenetic t-test p = 0.072
alpha_accli <- alpha_div %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(., sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == Tube_code)) %>%
  filter(time_point == "Acclimation")

alpha_accli %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean_liolepis = mean(value[species == "Podarcis_liolepis"]),
            mean_muralis = mean(value[species == "Podarcis_muralis"]),
            shapiro_p = shapiro.test(value)$p.value,
            var_test_p = var.test(value ~ species)$p.value,
            welch_t = t.test(value ~ species)$statistic,
            welch_p = t.test(value ~ species)$p.value,
            student_p = t.test(value ~ species, var.equal = TRUE)$p.value,
            wilcoxon_p = wilcox.test(value ~ species)$p.value) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 4))) %>%
  tt()
```

## Beta diversity

Number of samples used
```{r beta_div_neutral_accli_samples, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, comments=FALSE}
samples_to_keep_accli <- sample_metadata %>%
  filter(time_point == "Acclimation") %>% 
  select(Tube_code) %>% 
  pull()
subset_meta_accli <- sample_metadata %>%
  filter(time_point == "Acclimation")

length(samples_to_keep_accli)
```

```{r dispersion_helper_accli, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
# Homogeneity of multivariate dispersion: betadisper + permutest, 9,999 permutations, set.seed(123).
# Identical to supplementary_tables/table_S10_dispersion.R (same sample order, seed and call).
disp_test <- function(beta_obj, meta, group) {
  M <- as.matrix(beta_obj$S)
  ids <- meta$Tube_code[meta$Tube_code %in% rownames(M)]
  d <- as.dist(M[ids, ids])
  dat <- meta[match(labels(d), meta$Tube_code), ]
  set.seed(123)
  permutest(betadisper(d, factor(dat[[group]])), pairwise = TRUE, permutations = 9999)
}
```

### Richness
```{r beta_richness_permanova_1_accli, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
richness_accli <- as.matrix(beta_q0n$S)
richness_accli <- as.dist(richness_accli[rownames(richness_accli) %in% samples_to_keep_accli,
               colnames(richness_accli) %in% samples_to_keep_accli])
disp_test(beta_q0n, subset_meta_accli, "species")
```

```{r beta_richness_permanova_accli, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE, results=TRUE}
set.seed(123)
adonis2(richness_accli ~ species,
        data = subset_meta_accli %>% arrange(match(Tube_code,labels(richness_accli))),
        permutations = 9999) %>%
        broom::tidy() %>%
        tt()
```

### NMDS
```{r beta_neutral_nmds_accli, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE, results="hide"}
richness_accli %>%
  metaMDS(.,trymax = 500, k=2, verbosity=FALSE, trace=FALSE) %>%
  vegan::scores() %>%
  as_tibble(., rownames = "sample") %>%
  left_join(subset_meta_accli, by = join_by(sample == Tube_code))%>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  mutate(x_cen = mean(NMDS1, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(y_cen = mean(NMDS2, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x=NMDS1,y=NMDS2, color=species)) +
  scale_color_manual(name="species",
                     breaks=c("Podarcis_muralis","Podarcis_liolepis"),
                     labels=c("Podarcis muralis","Podarcis liolepis"),
                     values=c('#008080',"#d57d2c")) +

                     breaks=c("Cold_control", "Warm_control", "Cold_intervention"),
```

## Functional capacity
### Metabolic capacity index at functional level

```{r gitfs_elements_acclimation, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
GIFTs_functions_community %>%
  rowMeans() %>%
  as_tibble(., rownames = "sample") %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == Tube_code)) %>%
  filter(time_point=="Acclimation") %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(MCI = mean(value), sd = sd(value))
```
```{r gitfs_functional_acclimation_3, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
MCI_element_acclimation<- GIFTs_functions_community %>%
  rowMeans() %>%
  as_tibble(., rownames = "sample") %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == Tube_code)) %>%
  filter(time_point=="Acclimation")

shapiro.test(MCI_element_acclimation$value) #normality test
var.test(value ~ species, data = MCI_element_acclimation)
t.test(value ~ species, data=MCI_element_acclimation, var.equal = TRUE)
```

### Differences in functional pathways
```{r comunity_elem_acclimation, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
element_gift_acclimation<- element_gift %>% 
  filter(time_point=="Acclimation") %>% 
  select(-time_point,-type) %>%
  filter(rowSums(across(where(is.numeric), ~ . != 0)) > 0) %>%
  select(Tube_code, where(~ is.numeric(.) && sum(.) > 0)) %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata[c(1, 3)], by = "Tube_code")
```

```{r commun_wilcox_elem_acclimation, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
significant_elements_acclimation <- element_gift_acclimation %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(Tube_code,species), names_to = "trait", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(trait) %>%
  summarise(p_value = wilcox.test(value ~ species)$p.value) %>%
  mutate(p_adjust=p.adjust(p_value, method="BH")) %>%
  filter(p_adjust < 0.05)%>%
  rownames_to_column(., "Elements")  %>% 
  select(-Elements)

element_gift_sig_acclimation <- element_gift_acclimation %>%
  select(Tube_code, all_of(intersect(
    significant_elements_acclimation$trait,
    colnames(element_gift_acclimation)
  ))) %>%
  left_join(., sample_metadata[c(1, 3)], by = join_by(Tube_code == Tube_code))

difference_table_acclimation <- element_gift_sig_acclimation %>%
  select(-Tube_code) %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), mean)) %>%
  t() %>%
  row_to_names(row_number = 1) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate_if(is.character, as.numeric) %>%
  rownames_to_column(., "Elements") %>%
  left_join(.,uniqueGIFT_db[c(1,3,4)],by = join_by(Elements == Code_element)) %>% 
  arrange(Function) %>% 
  mutate(Difference=Podarcis_muralis-Podarcis_liolepis)%>% 
  mutate(group_color = ifelse(Difference <0, "Podarcis_liolepis","Podarcis_muralis")) 
```

```{r acclimation_trait_counts, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Functional traits (GIFT elements) differing between species after acclimation (Wilcoxon, BH p < 0.05).
# Manuscript: 16 traits; six shared with the wild comparison; GABA and glutamate biosynthesis enriched in warm-adapted (P. liolepis).
cat("Significant traits after acclimation (BH p < 0.05):", nrow(significant_elements_acclimation), "\n")
cat("Enriched in P. muralis (cold-adapted):", sum(difference_table_acclimation$Difference > 0), "\n")
cat("Enriched in P. liolepis (warm-adapted):", sum(difference_table_acclimation$Difference < 0), "\n")

# Wild comparison, recomputed with the same test so this chunk is self-contained
element_gift_wild_ref <- element_gift %>%
  filter(time_point == "Wild") %>%
  select(-time_point, -type) %>%
  filter(rowSums(across(where(is.numeric), ~ . != 0)) > 0) %>%
  select(Tube_code, where( ~ is.numeric(.) && sum(.) > 0)) %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata[c(1, 3)], by = "Tube_code")
significant_elements_wild_ref <- element_gift_wild_ref %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(Tube_code, species), names_to = "trait", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(trait) %>%
  summarise(p_value = wilcox.test(value ~ species)$p.value) %>%
  mutate(p_adjust = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  filter(p_adjust < 0.05)
cat("Significant traits in the wild (BH p < 0.05):", nrow(significant_elements_wild_ref), "\n")

shared_traits <- intersect(significant_elements_acclimation$trait, significant_elements_wild_ref$trait)
cat("Traits significant in both wild and acclimation:", length(shared_traits), "\n")
difference_table_acclimation %>%
  mutate(shared_with_wild = Elements %in% shared_traits,
         Difference = round(Difference, 4)) %>%
  select(Elements, Function, Difference, group_color, shared_with_wild) %>%
  arrange(desc(shared_with_wild), group_color, Function) %>%
  tt()
```

```{r commun_wilcox_elem_plot_acclimation, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=6, fig.width=12, fig.fullwidth=TRUE}
difference_table_acclimation %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=forcats::fct_reorder(Function,Difference), y=Difference, fill=group_color)) + 
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#d57d2c",'#008080')) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=0) +
```
